metadata.name: Ritual Documentation
metadata.description: Dokumentasi Ritual Foundation tentang blockchain, AI, dan fitur-fitur inovatif

documents.title: Account Abstraction
documents.summary: Ritual mengimplementasikan EIP-7702 untuk memperluas kemampuan akun EOA dengan fungsionalitas smart contract
chunks: Account Abstraction on Ritual fundamentally expands the capabilities of EOA accounts, enabling enhanced user experience.
Today, Ethereum-based blockchains support two types of accounts: Externally-owned accounts (EOAs) and Smart contract accounts.
Smart contract accounts enable limitless functionality: Batch calls, Gas fee sponsorship, Arbitrary signing keys, Advanced ACLs.
EIP-7702 adds a new transaction type, SetCodeTx, which enables EOA accounts to delegate a smart contract as their implementation.

documents.title: Crypto × AI
documents.summary: Mengapa AI perlu berada di blockchain untuk menjaga transparansi, menghindari monopoli, dan memastikan akses terbuka
chunks: It took ChatGPT just under two months to reach 100 million monthly active users.
The way AI predominantly exists today is not sustainable: Data & compute oligopoly, Closed model monopolies, Alignment autocracy.
Crypto is the only proven decentralizing force, enabling self-sovereign control of data and capital.
Ritual is purpose-built to decentralize access to AI compute: Enshrined compute, Censorship resistant, Composable.
Verifiable AI Provenance: Ritual enables open- and closed-source model verifiability.

documents.title: Enshrined On-Chain AI Models
documents.summary: Ritual menjadikan model AI sebagai first-class citizens di blockchain untuk interaksi atomic dengan smart contracts
chunks: Enshrined On-Chain AI Models enable native smart contract interactions with AI models.
Ritual takes a fundamentally different approach by making AI models first-class citizens on the blockchain.
Models exist as on-chain objects with: Verifiable provenance, Modular model authenticity, Direct smart contract integration.
Use cases: DeFi + AI, Governance, Gaming, Creator Economy.

documents.title: EVM++ Sidecars Overview
documents.summary: Ritual mengimplementasikan precompile sebagai sidecars terpisah yang dapat diskalakan secara paralel
chunks: Ritual enables expressive, heterogeneous compute via the EVM precompile contract interface.
Ritual's compute precompiles are implemented as disjoint sidecars that run and scale parallel to an execution client.
Supported sidecars: Classical ML Inference, LLM Inference, ZK Proving & Verification, TEE Execution, Chain Abstraction.

documents.title: Guardians
documents.summary: Guardians adalah firewall komputasi canggih untuk operasi node yang terspesialisasi
chunks: Guardians are advanced compute firewalls for specialized node operation.
Traditional blockchain nodes face a fundamental challenge: they must process all transactions uniformly.
Ritual Guardians enable computational and semantic filtering of blockchain operations.
Nodes can filter based on hardware requirements: AI model size, ZK circuit complexity, TEE code execution.
Statistical firewalls enable nodes to hyperspecialize based on prompt categories and topics.

documents.title: Infernet to Chain
documents.summary: Ritual menghubungkan 8,000+ node Infernet dengan blockchain untuk komputasi AI yang transparan
chunks: Ritual, with its underlying mesh of 8,000+ connected Infernet nodes, lets anyone, anywhere tap into transparent AI.
Centralized APIs are broken: geo-restrict access, require operator trust, and censor.
Infernet launched in November 2023 as the first decentralized oracle network for purpose-built AI workloads.
Chain-as-an-interface: Resonance is extended to enable routing compute requests to Infernet nodes.

documents.title: Model Marketplace
documents.summary: Ritual menciptakan marketplace terdesentralisasi untuk model AI dengan verifikasi dan royalti
chunks: As AI models become increasingly valuable assets, there is a growing need for decentralized marketplaces.
Ritual introduces foundational primitives that enable verifiable model marketplaces.
Enshrined AI Models become first-class citizens on the blockchain.
Verifiable Model Execution via vTune and SVE.
Model Monetization with vault-like architecture and royalty distribution.
Story Protocol and Sentient can leverage Ritual for IP management.

documents.title: Modular Storage
documents.summary: Pendekatan storage-agnostic dengan dukungan untuk Web2 (Hugging Face) dan Web3 (Arweave)
chunks: Modular Storage is a storage-agnostic approach to data, with support for Web2 and Web3 venues.
Modern blockchains operate with limited, expensive on-chain storage capabilities.
Ritual introduces a provider-agnostic approach to storage by abstracting storage access into repositories.
Native integration with both Web2 (via Hugging Face Hub) and Web3 (via Arweave) storage layers.

documents.title: Node Specialization
documents.summary: Ritual memperkenalkan spesialisasi node melalui arsitektur Execute-Once-Verify-Many-Times
chunks: Traditional blockchains like Ethereum operate by coming to consensus over ordering and replicated execution.
Ritual Chain introduces node specialization through architecture purpose-built for reducing redundant re-execution.
Symphony reduces replicated execution through dual proof sharding, distributed verification, and optimal sampling.
Resonance enables user preference, matching heterogeneous transactions to heterogeneous nodes.

documents.title: Prover Networks
documents.summary: Ritual sebagai jaringan prover untuk outsourcing pembuatan dan verifikasi ZK proof
chunks: Zero-knowledge (ZK) proof systems are becoming central to blockchain scalability and privacy.
Ritual's architecture provides a natural solution, enabling chains to outsource their proving needs.
Efficient Proof Generation through Resonance with specialized hardware matching.
Decentralized Verification via Symphony's EOVMT protocol.
Case Study: MegaETH can outsource proof generation to specialized nodes.

documents.title: Resonance
documents.summary: Mekanisme fee canggih untuk mencocokkan supply dan demand transaksi heterogen
chunks: Resonance is a state-of-the-art transaction fee mechanism to efficiently match supply and demand.
Blockchain transactions have become increasingly heterogeneous.
Existing fee mechanisms are insufficient, suffering from poor welfare guarantees.
Resonance is a two-sided market setting matching users to nodes.
Brokers are sophisticated, profit-seeking agents that compute matchings between transactions and nodes.

documents.title: Scheduled Transactions
documents.summary: Transaksi terjadwal untuk eksekusi otomatis fungsi smart contract secara berkala
chunks: We introduce a new predeploy contract, Scheduler.
Developers can easily set up scheduled smart contract invocations through Scheduler.schedule().
Scheduled transactions containing heterogeneous compute consume the same standard Scheduler interface.
Scheduled transactions have privileged inclusion at top-of-block.

documents.title: Symphony
documents.summary: Protokol konsensus baru untuk mengurangi replicated execution dan mendukung workload intensif
chunks: Symphony is a new consensus protocol to reduce replicated execution and enable high-performance, resource-intensive workloads.
Most blockchains today operate on replicated execution, where all nodes re-execute each block.
Symphony builds upon an Execute-Once-Verify-Many-Times (EOVMT) model.
Model partitioning, Proof sharding, Storing proof shards off-chain, Distributed verification.
Flexible proof systems: TEE Attestations, Zero-Knowledge Proofs, Hybrid Solutions.

documents.title: Verifiable Provenance
documents.summary: Melacak dan membuktikan provenance model AI dengan watermarking dan backdooring
chunks: Verifiable Provenance lets you track and prove the provenance of AI models.
The status quo of AI models today is dominated by centralized, closed source models.
Open-source incentivization is broken; creators expend resources but cannot recoup costs.
Proof of Provenance through watermarking: Weight space, Data watermarking, Function-space watermarking.
vTune: Verifiable Fine-Tuning for LLMs Through Backdooring, does not affect downstream performance.

documents.title: What is Ritual?
documents.summary: Pengantar lengkap tentang Ritual sebagai blockchain paling ekspresif untuk komputasi heterogen
chunks: Ritual is the most expressive blockchain in existence, with a single focus: enrich what users can do on-chain today.
Behind every magnitude increase in blockchain users lies an innovation that enables net-new behavior.
Ritual was born from a single focus: enrich what users can do on-chain today to attract the users of tomorrow.
Ritual makes smart contracts actually smart, allowing users to natively tap into on-chain AI.
Key innovations: Expressive Compute, Scheduled Transactions, Enshrined AI Models, Model Marketplace, Account Abstraction.
Resonance, Symphony, Node Specialization, Modular Storage, Guardians, Verifiable Provenance.
